# OsmAnd backend: LVGL UI, GPU vector map, OsmAnd core (routing, search).
# The LVGL/UI parts are also built on the host for the tests.

# LVGL and the design assets (fonts, icons; generated by assets-src/).
file(GLOB_RECURSE ONC_LVGL_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${ONC_ROOT}/third_party/lvgl/src/*.c)
file(GLOB ONC_UI_ASSET_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ui/assets/*.c)
add_library(lvgl STATIC ${ONC_LVGL_SOURCES} ${ONC_UI_ASSET_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(lvgl PUBLIC ${ONC_ROOT} ${ONC_ROOT}/third_party/lvgl)
target_compile_definitions(lvgl PUBLIC LV_CONF_PATH="backends/osmand/ui/lv_conf.h")
target_compile_options(lvgl PRIVATE -O2)
set_target_properties(lvgl PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
if(ONC_QNX)
  target_compile_options(lvgl PRIVATE ${ONC_TARGET_FLAGS})
endif()

# Navigation UI and guidance logic without OsmAnd (host-testable).
add_library(navigation_ui STATIC
  diagnostics.cpp guidance_tracker.cpp cluster_payload.cpp junction_shape.cpp camera_controller.cpp dev_menu.cpp
  route_check.cpp label_geometry.cpp search/search_index.cpp voice_prompts.cpp voice_worker.cpp
  voice_link.cpp qnx_pcm_out.cpp ui/compact_text.cpp ui/localization.cpp ui/navigation_model.cpp
  ui/navigation_view.cpp ui/overlay_occupancy.cpp ui/recents_store.cpp)
target_include_directories(navigation_ui PUBLIC ${ONC_ROOT}/include ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
# dlopen (voice_link.cpp looks up libmq): in libc on QNX, libdl on older glibc.
target_link_libraries(navigation_ui PUBLIC lvgl Threads::Threads ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
target_compile_options(navigation_ui PRIVATE ${ONC_WARNINGS})
set_target_properties(navigation_ui PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
if(ONC_QNX)
  target_compile_options(navigation_ui PRIVATE ${ONC_TARGET_FLAGS} -fvisibility=hidden)
endif()

# Voice daemon pieces that the plugin does not link (it keeps an exact, reviewed
# dependency set): the process-backed audio focus. Host-testable.
add_library(voice_daemon STATIC process_focus.cpp)
target_include_directories(voice_daemon PUBLIC ${ONC_ROOT}/include ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_link_libraries(voice_daemon PUBLIC navigation_ui)
target_compile_options(voice_daemon PRIVATE ${ONC_WARNINGS})
set_target_properties(voice_daemon PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
if(ONC_QNX)
  target_compile_options(voice_daemon PRIVATE ${ONC_TARGET_FLAGS})
else()
  return()
endif()

# navi_voiced: the speech daemon (docs/design/voice-guidance-wiring.md). It needs
# RHVoice built for QNX by uk-voice/tts/build.sh; pass the build tree and headers:
#   -DRHVOICE_BUILD=<tts-qnx>/build/rhvoice-qnx -DRHVOICE_INCLUDE=<tts-qnx>/dl/RHVoice/src/include
if(RHVOICE_BUILD AND RHVOICE_INCLUDE)
  file(GLOB_RECURSE ONC_RHVOICE_OBJECTS CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    ${RHVOICE_BUILD}/src/core/*.o ${RHVOICE_BUILD}/src/hts_engine/*.o ${RHVOICE_BUILD}/src/lib/*.o)
  set_source_files_properties(${ONC_RHVOICE_OBJECTS} PROPERTIES EXTERNAL_OBJECT TRUE GENERATED TRUE)
  add_executable(navi_voiced navi_voiced.cpp rhvoice_engine.cpp ${ONC_RHVOICE_OBJECTS})
  target_include_directories(navi_voiced PRIVATE ${RHVOICE_INCLUDE})
  target_compile_options(navi_voiced PRIVATE ${ONC_WARNINGS} ${ONC_TARGET_FLAGS})
  target_link_libraries(navi_voiced PRIVATE voice_daemon navigation_ui asound m)
  # libasound needs libpps.so.1, which the linker only finds through -rpath-link.
  target_link_options(navi_voiced PRIVATE -static-libstdc++ -static-libgcc
    -Wl,-rpath-link,${CMAKE_SYSROOT}/armle-v7/lib)
  set_target_properties(navi_voiced PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}
    SKIP_BUILD_RPATH ON)
endif()

# ---- QNX: the plugin ------------------------------------------------------
set(OSMAND_CORE_LIB_DIR ${OSMAND_QNX_ROOT}/source/binaries/qnx/gcc-armv7/Release)
set(OSMAND_QT_PREFIX ${OSMAND_QNX_ROOT}/qt-prefix)
set(_core ${OSMAND_QNX_ROOT}/source/core)
set(_ext ${_core}/externals)
add_library(osmand_core SHARED IMPORTED GLOBAL)
set_target_properties(osmand_core PROPERTIES
  IMPORTED_LOCATION ${OSMAND_CORE_LIB_DIR}/libOsmAndCore_shared.so)
set(ONC_OSMAND_INCLUDES
  ${_core}/include ${OSMAND_QNX_ROOT}/source/core-legacy/native/include
  ${OSMAND_QNX_ROOT}/source/core-legacy/native/src
  ${_ext}/protobuf/upstream.patched/src ${_ext}/glm/upstream.patched
  ${_ext}/boost/upstream.patched ${_ext}/skia/upstream.patched
  ${_ext}/skia/upstream.patched/include/core ${_ext}/skia/upstream.patched/include/effects
  ${_ext}/skia/upstream.patched/src/core ${_ext}/expat/upstream.patched/lib
  ${_ext}/harfbuzz/upstream.patched/src ${_ext}/freetype/upstream.patched/include
  ${OSMAND_QT_PREFIX}/include ${OSMAND_QT_PREFIX}/include/QtCore
  ${OSMAND_QT_PREFIX}/include/QtNetwork)
# OsmAnd's own headers are noisy; their warnings stay warnings.
set(ONC_OSMAND_FLAGS ${ONC_TARGET_FLAGS} -fvisibility=hidden
  -Wno-error=ignored-attributes -Wno-error=deprecated-declarations
  -Wno-error=unused-function -Wno-error=unused-parameter -Wno-error=unused-variable
  -Wno-error=sign-compare -Wno-error=ignored-qualifiers)
set(ONC_OSMAND_DEFINES _HAS_C9X=1 _NO_CPP_INLINES=1 _HAS_GENERIC_TEMPLATES=0
  OSMAND_COMPILER_FAMILY_gcc OSMAND_TARGET_OS_qnx OSMAND_TARGET_CPU_ARCH_armv7
  OSMAND_TARGET_CPU_ARCH_FAMILY_arm OSMAND_OPENGLES2PLUS_RENDERER_SUPPORTED
  SK_SUPPORT_LEGACY_DRAWLOOPER)
set(ONC_OSMAND_INCLUDES ${ONC_OSMAND_INCLUDES} PARENT_SCOPE)
set(ONC_OSMAND_FLAGS ${ONC_OSMAND_FLAGS} PARENT_SCOPE)
set(ONC_OSMAND_DEFINES ${ONC_OSMAND_DEFINES} PARENT_SCOPE)

# The backend's git description for the developer menu; the generated file
# changes only when the description does.
set(_build_info ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/build_info_git.h)
add_custom_target(build_info_git
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -DOUT=${_build_info} -DREPO=${ONC_ROOT}
          -P ${ONC_ROOT}/cmake/build_info.cmake
  BYPRODUCTS ${_build_info} VERBATIM)

# Turn instructions: Organic Maps' car turn generator on OsmAnd's routes
# (omaps_turns.cpp; the vendored OM code in third_party/organicmaps-routing). A
# static library so that OM's shim headers stay out of the backend's include path.
include(${ONC_ROOT}/third_party/organicmaps-routing/sources.cmake)
add_library(organicmaps_turns STATIC omaps_turns.cpp ${ONC_ORGANICMAPS_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(organicmaps_turns PRIVATE ${ONC_ORGANICMAPS_INCLUDES}
                           ${ONC_OSMAND_INCLUDES} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_compile_definitions(organicmaps_turns PRIVATE ${ONC_OSMAND_DEFINES})
# Vendored code: its warnings are upstream's.
target_compile_options(organicmaps_turns PRIVATE ${ONC_OSMAND_FLAGS} -w)

add_library(osmand_backend SHARED
  osmand_backend.cpp config.cpp session.cpp osmand_engine.cpp navigation_worker.cpp ch_planner.cpp
  route_maneuvers.cpp
  thread_priority.cpp crash_reporter.cpp frame_metrics.cpp build_info.cpp
  gpu_upload_context.cpp
  ui/gl_overlay_compositor.cpp
  vector/vector_map.cpp vector/vector_style.cpp vector/vector_tessellator.cpp
  vector/coastline.cpp)
add_dependencies(osmand_backend build_info_git)
target_include_directories(osmand_backend PRIVATE ${ONC_OSMAND_INCLUDES}
                           ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR})
target_compile_definitions(osmand_backend PRIVATE ${ONC_OSMAND_DEFINES})
target_compile_options(osmand_backend PRIVATE ${ONC_WARNINGS} ${ONC_OSMAND_FLAGS})
target_link_libraries(osmand_backend PRIVATE navigation_ui organicmaps_turns osmand_core EGL GLESv2 z c)
set_target_properties(osmand_backend PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME OpenNaviBackendOsmAnd
  LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR} SKIP_BUILD_RPATH ON)
target_link_options(osmand_backend PRIVATE -Wl,--as-needed -static-libstdc++ -static-libgcc
  -Wl,-Bsymbolic -Wl,-soname,libOpenNaviBackendOsmAnd.so
  -Wl,-rpath,/open-navicore
  -Wl,--version-script=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/osmand_backend.map
  -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,--no-undefined -Wl,-z,text)
add_custom_command(TARGET osmand_backend POST_BUILD
  COMMAND ${QNX_ENV} READELF=${QNX_READELF} sh ${ONC_ROOT}/tests/check_osmand_elf.sh
          $<TARGET_FILE:osmand_backend>
  VERBATIM)

# Bench-only route calculation timer (deploy/bench/route_bench.cpp; not in
# navigation.ifs). A shared library like the plugin (an executable cannot
# link the core with a static libgcc) plus a dlopen launcher; both run from
# /tmp on the radio against the /open-navicore libraries.
add_library(route_bench SHARED ${ONC_ROOT}/deploy/bench/route_bench.cpp
  ${ONC_ROOT}/deploy/bench/map_tags.cpp ${ONC_ROOT}/backends/osmand/ch_planner.cpp)
target_include_directories(route_bench PRIVATE ${ONC_OSMAND_INCLUDES})
target_compile_definitions(route_bench PRIVATE ${ONC_OSMAND_DEFINES})
target_compile_options(route_bench PRIVATE ${ONC_OSMAND_FLAGS} -w)
target_link_libraries(route_bench PRIVATE osmand_core m c)
set_target_properties(route_bench PROPERTIES LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bench
  SKIP_BUILD_RPATH ON)
target_link_options(route_bench PRIVATE -static-libstdc++ -static-libgcc -Wl,-Bsymbolic
  -Wl,-rpath,/open-navicore)
add_executable(route_bench_run ${ONC_ROOT}/deploy/bench/route_bench_run.c)
target_link_libraries(route_bench_run PRIVATE c)
set_target_properties(route_bench_run PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bench)
